correctness.rationale: Composition maps are exactly encoded by binary strings with unique fixed-length affine representation. Nonoverlapping occurrences of 01 yield the parse multiplicity binom(M,L-n), exact rational semigroup growth series, and conditional equiprobability. The entropy chain rule and LLN plus uniform Stirling bound prove the all-weight entropy formula. The published all-similarity entropy-dimension theorem applies; an independent geometric-gap relative-entropy argument forces strict dimension <1. An exact exhaustive finite verifier checks n=0..9 and independent entropy identities (33428 assertions). Finite checks are supporting rather than infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Compared exact affine semigroup products, word growth, all-weight entropy, and dimension implications. Kittle--Kogler 2026 gives the universal dimension theorem; Varju 2025/2026 states the algebraic weak-separation precursor and defines entropy. Böcherer et al. 2009 explicitly use the same ambiguous tokens 0,1,01, but their Section V only exhibits and rejects naive source entropy, without deriving collision-adjusted H(G_n), asymptotic all-weight entropy, semigroup counts, or dimension. The prior code/example is acknowledged; the quantitative correction, not the choice of example, is assessed as original. Residual priority risk remains.
residual_risks: The identical codeword set was published in 2009, without this corrected entropy; another treatment of three-token ambiguous renewal sources or finite-type self-similar measures may contain an equivalent explicit formula under different names.
The broad entropy-dimension implication was already established in the algebraic weak-separation setting and is not claimed as new.
Public cross-slot searches and the inspected sources cannot rule out unpublished or unindexed duplicate findings.

value.rationale: Böcherer et al. 2009 explicitly used the identical 0,1,01 code to illustrate a naive entropy paradox, but left the actual merged-output entropy uncomputed. The all-weight correction closes this exact mathematical gap, solves the entropy input for general similarity dimension theory, and quantitatively explains why the code produces full-support singular stationary laws. An exact growth series for all generator times adds structural information; the contribution is a complete natural special-case classification, not a generic dimension theorem.
